name: 3. CSAT v6 - Super Admin Human Handoff

nodes.name: Send Super Admin Handoff
nodes.notes: No automatic SMTP retry: an ambiguous timeout may already have delivered. Check the provider before retrying. Do not add CC, BCC, service owners or fixed fallback recipients.

parameters.content:
## Cluster email policy — application update required
Select Header Auth: x-csat-webhook-secret = Replit production N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Confirm the preserved SMTP credential.
Only explicit handoff / post-completion handoff events; Super Admins only.
Use the application template and exact recipient lists. No old Config address, manager/owner additions, automatic SMTP retries or stale execution replays.
Success means all recipients were accepted by SMTP, NOT verified inbox delivery. Import inactive; replace the old workflow on the same webhook path when the application is ready.
